name: Yes, I'm alone 2.
source:
This novel continues from the good ending of the previous title, where you must try to adapt your new transformation. You decide whether to go along with the Pale Man... or, on the contrary, rebel against him... 

[Edited from [url=https://mourners.itch.io/yes-im-alone-2]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作承接前作的好结局，你必须设法适应自己身上的全新异变。你将做出抉择：是顺从那名苍白男子的意志……还是奋起反抗他……

[摘自[url=https://mourners.itch.io/yes-im-alone-2]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
